articles.summary: Legora, the agentic operating system for legal professionals, today announced that Salesforce has adopted Legora across its Legal and Corporate Affairs organization in North America, EMEA, and APAC, complementing its use of Agentforce and Slack.
articles.title: Salesforce selects Legora to further support its global legal team operations

articles.summary: Bradley is rolling out Legora to more than 750 lawyers across 13 offices, as well as the business functions that support them.
articles.title: Bradley goes firm-wide with Legora

articles.summary: Edwin Coe, the leading independent London law firm, has made Legora available for all its lawyers to use, with training designed around the work of each individual team.
articles.title: Edwin Coe rolls out Legora firm-wide across all 14 practice groups

articles.summary: A large part of legal work begins with research: establishing what the law is and whether it still applies. It is also the step where AI has proved hardest to trust. Legora hosted a webinar on what it takes to build legal research natively for AI.
articles.title: Webinar: Rewiring Legal Research for an AI-Native Future

articles.summary: Legora partners with The American Law Institute, bringing their Restatements of the Law into the Legora platform.
articles.title: Legora Partners with The American Law Institute to bring Restatements of the Law into their legal research platform

articles.summary: Legora, the agentic operating system for legal professionals, is putting a new foundation under legal research in its platform: comprehensive data built on a full ontology of law and an AI-native citator.
articles.title: Legora rebuilds legal research with comprehensive data, a full ontology of law, and an AI-native citator

articles.summary: Matthew J. Madsen is the Managing Partner of Harrison LLP, a national law firm that focuses exclusively on helping clients define and achieve their private wealth goals. The firm now has more than 100 attorneys across 12 markets, and counts 14 Fellows of the American College of Trust and Estate Counsel among its ranks.
articles.title: Creating more value in less time: How the Managing Partner of Harrison LLP became one of Legora's top power users

articles.summary: Legora, the agentic operating system for legal work, today announced a collaboration with Veolia, the global benchmark company for ecological transformation, to support Veolia's Group Legal function with an AI-enabled workflow across day-to-day legal tasks.
articles.title: Veolia selects Legora to power AI-enabled legal work across its global legal function

articles.summary: Legora, the agentic operating system for legal professionals, and Singapore Management University (SMU) today announced that SMU’s Yong Pung How School of Law is joining Legora's Legal AI Scholars Program, becoming the first university in Asia to do so.
articles.title: Singapore Management University partners with Legora to bring agentic AI to its law school

articles.summary: Having worked as a lawyer, a client, and in legal technology, Ricardo Anaya was unusually well prepared for what he does today: translating legal workflows and judgment into effective ways of using Legora. That discipline has become known as legal engineering, and Ricardo was ideally placed to help establish it for Legora in the US.
articles.title: Ricardo Anaya on starting out as Legora’s first US legal engineer

articles.summary: Giving lawyers new tools inside old processes only speeds up their work, but the real gains come from changing the process itself.
articles.title: The real cost of legal intake

articles.summary: Legora is now available inside ChatGPT Enterprise, giving lawyers a direct line to grounded legal answers with citations.
articles.title: Legora announces its plugin for ChatGPT Enterprise
